name: markdown-ai-studio
description: AI Markdown Studio Community combines open-source Markdown authoring with AI-assisted document and MPS generation, live previews, HTML export, and basic DOCX export.
author: Gustavo Serpa

languageModelTools.name: markdown_ai_studio_build_presentation_prompt
languageModelTools.displayName: Build Markdown AI Studio Presentation Prompt
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Builds a complete, self-contained Markdown AI Studio prompt for creating a Markdown Presentation Specification .md deck. Use this when the user wants to generate a presentation deck that previews and exports correctly in Markdown AI Studio. The prompt includes slide layout, density, image, speaker notes, theme, ratio guidance, the rule that each slide directive must appear once immediately after the slide separator and before the slide title, and workspace-aware guidance on whether remote image embeds should be used or avoided based on `markdownAiStudio.allowRemoteResources`. This tool does not call an AI model and does not write files.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Build a Markdown AI Studio presentation-generation prompt.

audience.description: The intended audience. Defaults to a general audience.

tone.description: The desired tone, such as professional, executive, technical, storytelling, warm, or fun.

slideCount.description: Target number of slides. Defaults to 8.

theme.description: Markdown AI Studio presentation theme. Defaults to galaxy.

languageModelTools.name: markdown_ai_studio_validate_presentation
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validates Markdown Presentation Specification content for Markdown AI Studio. Use this to check whether a generated .md deck has presentation front matter, slide separators, valid structure, slide titles, and correctly placed slide directives. Accepts either raw Markdown or a workspace file URI. This tool is read-only.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Validate a Markdown AI Studio presentation deck.

markdown.description: Raw Markdown presentation content to validate.

uri.description: A file URI inside the current workspace to validate.

languageModelTools.name: markdown_ai_studio_save_markdown_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new Markdown file inside the current workspace from provided Markdown content. Use only after the user has approved saving a generated Markdown AI Studio presentation or document. The tool never overwrites existing files; it creates a unique filename. This tool has workspace write side effects.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Save generated Markdown into the current workspace.

filename.description: File name for the Markdown file. Must be a file name, not a path.

content.description: Complete Markdown file content to save.

workspaceRelativeDirectory.description: Optional directory relative to the workspace folder. Defaults to the workspace root.

markdownAiStudio.allowRemoteResources.description: Allow remote resources in previews and installed feature contributions.

enumDescriptions: AI commands stay visible when GitHub Copilot is configured, and the disclosure appears the first time an AI feature actually tries to run.
AI features may use the GitHub Copilot service already configured in VS Code for AI-supported functionality such as document generation, presentation generation, and AI Paste to Markdown.
AI-supported commands stay hidden, while Enable AI Features... remains available so you can review and change this choice later.
markdownAiStudio.aiAccess.description: Controls whether AI Markdown Studio may use the GitHub Copilot service already configured in VS Code for AI-supported functionality. Choose Enabled only if you are authorized to share that content through the configured Copilot service.

markdownAiStudio.aiModel.description: Preferred Copilot model family. If unavailable or unsuccessful, AI Markdown Studio tries gpt-5.4-mini and then the first available Copilot model.
